title: Aegis Users & Platform
_comment: Bump `version` on every edit — Grafana's file provisioner ignores a changed dashboard whose version did not increase.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "users" FROM users

panels.title: Active now (15m)
panels.description: Access tokens are stateless, so there is no session to count. This is users who made an authenticated request in the last 15 minutes — the honest version of 'signed in right now'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "active" FROM users WHERE last_seen_at > now() - interval '15 minutes'
SELECT count(*) AS "active" FROM users WHERE last_seen_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT count(*) AS "active" FROM users WHERE last_seen_at > now() - interval '30 days'
SELECT count(*) AS "signups" FROM users WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Email verified
panels.description: Unverified accounts that never convert are the usual sign of a broken or spam-filtered verification mail.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE email_verified)::float / greatest(count(*), 1) AS "verified" FROM users
SELECT count(*) AS "paying" FROM users WHERE subscription_tier <> 'free' AND subscription_status IN ('active', 'trialing')
SELECT count(*) AS "deactivated" FROM users WHERE is_active = false

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS "signups"
FROM users
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily active users
panels.description: Distinct people who did something auditable that day (created a scan, changed a member, issued a token). last_seen_at only holds the latest visit, so history comes from the audit log — this counts doers, not browsers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(DISTINCT actor_user_id) AS "active users"
FROM audit_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND actor_user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT now() AS time, count(*) AS value, subscription_tier AS metric
FROM users
GROUP BY subscription_tier

SELECT now() AS time, count(*) AS value, subscription_status AS metric
FROM users
GROUP BY subscription_status

SELECT created_at AS "signed up", email, coalesce(display_name, '—') AS name,
       subscription_tier AS tier, email_verified AS verified, last_seen_at AS "last seen"
FROM users
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT last_seen_at AS "last seen", email, subscription_tier AS tier,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM scans s WHERE s.created_by_user_id = u.id) AS scans
FROM users u
WHERE last_seen_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Activation rate
panels.description: Share of accounts that have ever started a scan. The single number that says whether signups turn into users.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT created_by_user_id) FROM scans)::float
       / greatest((SELECT count(*) FROM users), 1) AS "activated"

panels.title: Accepted scan terms
panels.description: Scanning is gated on this attestation (see SECURITY.md), so it is also the last step before a user can do anything useful.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE scan_terms_accepted_at IS NOT NULL)::float / greatest(count(*), 1) AS "accepted" FROM users

panels.title: Signed up but never seen since
panels.description: Accounts older than a day with no authenticated request recorded. Dead signups.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "dormant" FROM users WHERE last_seen_at IS NULL AND created_at < now() - interval '1 day'

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE github_token IS NOT NULL OR gitlab_token IS NOT NULL OR bitbucket_token IS NOT NULL)::float
       / greatest(count(*), 1) AS "connected"
FROM users
SELECT count(*) AS "orgs" FROM organizations

panels.title: Members per org (avg)
panels.description: Above 1 means the product is spreading inside a company rather than sitting with one person.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::float / greatest((SELECT count(*) FROM organizations), 1) AS "members" FROM org_memberships
SELECT count(*) AS "targets" FROM targets
SELECT count(*) AS "scans" FROM scans WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
SELECT count(*) AS "findings" FROM vulnerabilities WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: LLM spend (30d)
panels.description: Cost of goods sold. Compare against what those users pay.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) AS "spend" FROM scans WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS value, status AS metric
FROM scans
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS value, severity AS metric
FROM vulnerabilities
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) AS "cost"
FROM scans
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top organizations (30d)
panels.description: Who actually uses the platform, and what they cost to serve.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.name AS org,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM org_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = o.id) AS members,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM targets t WHERE t.organization_id = o.id) AS targets,
       count(s.id) AS scans,
       coalesce(sum(s.cost_usd), 0) AS spend
FROM organizations o
LEFT JOIN targets t ON t.organization_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.target_id = t.id AND s.created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY o.id, o.name
ORDER BY scans DESC, spend DESC
LIMIT 20
